Is Dioclinic dangerous? Explanation of actual reviews and reasons why they are said to be suspicious

“Is it true that Dioclinic is dangerous and suspicious?”

“What should I do if I can’t refuse through counseling?”

There are probably many people who are looking into this with the same concerns mentioned above.

dio clinicis said to be “dangerous/suspicious” becauseGap between advertised price and actual total amountYaComplex application conditions、Atmosphere of being rushed to sign a counseling contractagainstfeeling of anxietyis a big factor.

Dioclinic isFat cooling/EMS/High/GLP-1This is a clinic that provides a medical diet that combinesUntransparent pricing and forced solicitationThere are a certain number of reviews pointing out the complexity of the plan.

Not all of the reputations of being “bad” are true, butRisks you should know before signing a contractIt is certain that there is.

In this article, we will explain the main reasons why Dioclinic is said to be dangerous, based on reviews from an original survey of 35 people who have used Dioclinic.

before signing a contractUnderstand fees and risks correctlyand decide if it's right for you.

What you can learn from this article
  • Good and bad reviews posted by Dioclinic users
  • 5 specific reasons why Dioclinic is called “dangerous and suspicious”
  • Price plans for each course provided by Dioclinic
Supervisor of this article

Yoshitomo Chihara

Director of Norris Beauty Clinic

Postdoctoral Researcher, Norris Cancer Center, University of Southern California;National Cancer Center PathologyHead of the club,Nara Prefectural Medical UniversityLecturer in Molecular Pathology,Saiseikai Chuwa HospitalAfter serving as head of the urology departmentnorris beauty clinicOpened a hospital.

Norris Beauty Clinic’s content production policy regarding aesthetic medicine

Norris Beauty Clinic operates with the aim of disseminating accurate and easy-to-understand information to our readers about aesthetic medicine, such as medical diets (GLP-1 receptor agonists, fat freezing, fat-dissolving injections, liposuction, etc.) and double plastic surgery.

Cosmetic treatments such as medical diets and double plastic surgery are important themes that are closely related to each individual's health condition, constitution, cost, and schedule.

We create content with an emphasis on reliability, neutrality, and safety so that our readers can calmly make choices that are suitable for them and prepare for advance counseling.

■Basic policy for content production

■Production flow

At our media, we create content through the following process.

Production flow
  1. Search needs/concerns survey
  2. Configuration design (organizing comparison standards and points to note)
  3. Writing/editing/fact checking
  4. Regular updates to the latest prices and medical system

■Regarding reliability of information

When writing articles, we use the following public institutions and highly reliable information sources.

An example of reference data for this media
  • Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare(Medical advertising guidelines/Pharmaceuticals Act related information)
  • PMDA (Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices Agency)
  • Japan Obesity Society・Japanese Society of Aesthetic Surgery (JSAS)Related academic societies such as
  • Consumer Affairs Agency(Related to the Specified Commercial Transactions Act and the Act on Premiums and Representations)
  • Official website information of each medical institution/pharmaceutical company

In addition, we regularly review information in response to price revisions, changes in clinic hours, updated guidelines, etc.

■Commitment to neutrality and transparency

Guaranteeing neutrality and objectivity
  • Specifies not only the benefits of each treatment but also side effects, risks, and downtime.
  • Presents points to note regarding total costs and cancellation regulations (cooling-off, etc.) for free medical treatment.
  • Do not use definitive expressions such as ``always'' or ``absolutely'' regarding changes or progress that vary from person to person.
  • Information is posted based on objective facts regardless of whether there is a partnership or not.

In order to correctly decipher trends in reviews, it is important to distinguish which treatment the post is about and when it was written.

The subject of evaluation is different for a negative post immediately after counseling and a positive post after multiple treatments.

Below, we will summarize the positive and negative trends and the characteristics of reviews by treatment.

Good reviews on changes after undergoing medical weight loss

Although they stated that there was no solicitation, it was obvious that they were trying to get me to sign a contract in various ways, and I thought it was a bit pushy.

Quote:Dioclinic Ikebukuro-in – Google Maps

There is no obligation to sign a contract on the day of your first consultation. If the contract falls under Specified Continuous Services, cooling-off can be considered within 8 days from the date of receipt of the contract document.

What is cooling-off?

If you have entered into a contract for products or services through door-to-door sales or telemarketing, this system allows you to unconditionally withdraw your application or cancel the contract within 8 days, including the day you applied for purchase or signed the contract (the day you received the document).

Source:Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications Fire and Disaster Management Agency | What is the cooling-off system?

The period covered by the cooling-off system varies depending on the transaction.

It is important to check how long your transactions will be covered.

Dioclinic services tend to be relatively expensive because they are made to order.

However, you can reduce costs by using a monitor plan or narrowing down the treatment to the bare minimum, so be sure to consult with your doctor before deciding on a plan.

Additionally, because clinics have a large number of users, it is often difficult to make reservations during busy hours or at stores near urban areas.

When it comes to making reservations, you can make your visit a little easier by adjusting your usage times, so we recommend making reservations for the following times.

Relatively convenient times
  • Weekday mornings (around 10:00-12:00)
  • Afternoon on weekdays (around 13:00-16:00)
  • Before the last reception on weekdays (after 19:00) *Depends on the hospital
  • First thing in the morning on Saturdays, Sundays, and holidays (immediately after opening)
  • Available slots from the day before to the day when cancellations are likely to occur
  • Weekdays after long holidays or in the middle of the month

Furthermore, negative reviews include nausea and constipation caused by diet drugs.side effectsThere were also comments regarding.

In fact, when we asked questions about the presence or absence of side effects in our own questionnaire survey, we found that60％is betterThere were side effectswas the answer.

Regarding side effects, be sure to check with your doctor or staff whenever you are concerned about them, and be sure to know what to do in case they occur.

These dissatisfaction are often the result of not checking the fees, conditions, and cancellation rules in writing before signing the contract, and some of these problems can be prevented by checking in advance.

When attending counseling,Total amount, cancellation conditions, application requirements for benefitsPlease be sure to confirm this in writing before signing.

Reviews on treatment plan (fat cooling, EMS, high, GLP-1)

Dio Clinic's reviews also included their impressions of each treatment plan.

The actual reviews posted are as follows:

EMS that acts on fat cooling and muscles was also effective.

It's encouraging to see my body shape change as I continue with the treatment, and to see the numbers change when I step on the scale.

Quote:Dioclinic Kyotoin – Google Maps

Although the fat freezing and HYF treatments are a little painful, I think they are paying off, so I am very satisfied.

Quote:Dioclinic Shinjuku-in – Google Maps

fat coolingSince fat cells decrease over several weeks immediately after the treatment, many posts say that it takes time to feel the effects.

While some people have said that they could not notice any changes after just one treatment, there have also been reports from users who have had the treatment three or more times that they have felt a partial size reduction.

EMSis a treatment that uses electrical stimulation to contract muscles, and a mix of comments include ``I was surprised at how strong the sensations were during the treatment'' and ``I feel like my core has tightened.''

Highis a treatment that uses ultrasound to heat the subcutaneous tissue, and there are relatively many positive posts saying that ``the sagging of the face and abdomen has improved.''

GLP-1While many people say that they have experienced the effect of suppressing appetite,Side effects such as nausea and fatigueThere have also been confirmed posts that have experienced this.

GLP-1 is a drug that requires a doctor's prescription. If you experience any symptoms of side effects, do not discontinue use on your own and consult your doctor.

When choosing a treatment, ask your doctor to explain the mechanism and expected effects of each treatment in advance, and check whether it suits your goals before making your decision.

Also, see below for information on the types of treatments received by people who have used medical diets at Dioclinic.

5 reasons why Dioclinic is called “dangerous and suspicious”

The reputation of Dioclinic as ``dangerous'' and ``suspicious'' stems from a specific experience.Specific complaints piled upIt's a thing.

5 reasons why people say it's "dangerous"
  • The total fee is not clear and there are cases where it becomes expensive after signing the contract.
  • Many users feel that solicitations during counseling are forced.
  • There are complicated application conditions for the benefits that can be used.
  • Effects vary from person to person, and people tend to feel that their expectations are not met.
  • There are a certain number of reviews regarding cancellation/refund problems.

The article does not confirm any evidence that it is illegal as a medical institution.

Still, the reason why Dioclinic is said to be dangerous is thatFee structure, solicitation method, and conditions for applying benefitsThis is because there are cases where users' expectations and reality do not match in three respects.
